scope: Local in-memory API harness, explicit fetch mocks only, zero network or real email

evidence.name: RED: email:false cancels own queued/failed before settings save returns
evidence.assertion:
Expected values to be strictly deep-equal:
+ actual - expected

  [
+   'queued',
+   'failed'
-   'cancelled',
-   'cancelled'
  ]

evidence.name: RED: cancellation failure rolls back email:false in the same transaction
evidence.assertion:
email consent update must roll back when atomic cancellation fails

false !== true

evidence.name: RED: successful provider id survives in the outbox record
evidence.assertion:
provider receipt id must be durable, regardless of chosen column name

false !== true

evidence.name: RED: concurrent deliver calls make at most one in-flight provider request per row
evidence.assertion:
concurrent workers must not both dispatch the same row

2 !== 1

evidence.name: RED: two concurrent retries from attempts=2 do not exceed the three-attempt ceiling
evidence.assertion: attempt ceiling must be enforced by the write/claim, not only the earlier SELECT

evidence.name: RED: a late concurrent provider failure cannot overwrite an accepted sent row
evidence.assertion:
stale failure must not replace an already accepted send

'failed' !== 'sent'

evidence.name: CONTROL: existing send-time consent recheck blocks provider dispatch after opt-out
